minecrafttweak.text.error.not_loaded: The config is not loaded yet.
minecrafttweak.feature.xp_pickup.desc: Shortens the wait between picking up experience orbs (vanilla: 2 ticks).
minecrafttweak.config.copied: Copied the current settings code to the clipboard.
minecrafttweak.config.details.tooltip: Open the detailed settings of this feature.
minecrafttweak.config.details.title: %s - Details
minecrafttweak.feature.xp_pickup.delay.d: Ticks to wait after picking up an orb before the next one can be picked up.
minecrafttweak.codes.title: Settings Code IDs
minecrafttweak.code.error.client_only: %s is a client setting. Import it from the config screen.
minecrafttweak.code.error.not_installed: %s belongs to %s, which is not installed.
minecrafttweak.code.error.unavailable: %s does not exist in the installed mod version.
minecrafttweak.code.error.no_prefix: No settings match the prefix of %s.
minecrafttweak.config.import.tooltip: Import the code in the box. You can paste a mod code and a video code together, separated by a space.
minecrafttweak.config.copy_mod.tooltip: Copy the settings of this mod and Quark that differ from the defaults.
minecrafttweak.config.copy_client.toolti: Copy the vanilla, Sodium and Sodium Extra settings that differ from the defaults.
minecrafttweak.config.compress.tooltip: When on, copied codes are compressed into short text (MT2.~). Paste them as is to import.
minecrafttweak.config.reset_first.toolti: When on, every setting on the side the code covers (mod / video) is reset to its default before importing.
minecrafttweak.config.copied_empty: Nothing differs from the defaults, so there is nothing to copy.
minecrafttweak.code.error.compressed: Could not read the compressed code. Make sure it is not cut off.
minecrafttweak.feature.system_language.d: Adds "System language" to the top of the language list. Picking it makes the game follow the language of your computer, and catch up the next time you start the game if it changes. Picking another language stops following it.
minecrafttweak.feature.custom_menu_music: Plays your own music (.ogg, .mp3 or .wav, from a URL or a file) on the menu screens. Set the location in the details, or press Browse to pick a file.
A URL (https://...) or a file path of an .ogg, .mp3 or .wav file. Press Browse to pick a file. Downloaded music is kept in config/minecrafttweak/music_cache.
When off, the music plays once each time you open the menu.
minecrafttweak.feature.pause_music.desc: Plays the title screen music while the pause screen is open, including music changed by mods like the Aether. Uses the custom menu music if it is on.
minecrafttweak.menu_music.error.too_big: The file is too big (50 MB max)
minecrafttweak.menu_music.error.channels: Use mono or stereo music (%s channels)
minecrafttweak.config.browse.tooltip: Pick a music file on your computer.
minecrafttweak.config.browse.title: Choose a music file
minecrafttweak.feature.english_search.de: Lets you search items by their English names as well as the names in your language. Works in the creative inventory, the recipe book, JEI, EMI and AE2 terminals. After turning it on or off, rejoin the world for JEI and EMI to pick it up.
minecrafttweak.config.code_screen.toolti: Import or copy setting codes, and open the ID list.
minecrafttweak.config.home_help: Pick a category to turn its features on or off.
minecrafttweak.feature.coyote_time.desc: You can still jump for a moment after walking off a ledge (once per fall).
minecrafttweak.feature.coyote_time.ticks: How many ticks after leaving the ground you can still jump (20 ticks = 1 second).
minecrafttweak.feature.energy_cube_stack: Mekanism energy cubes of the same tier and energy stack. When you pick up a cube, cubes whose energy differs by at most the pickup range are matched to the lower one. When you stack cubes by hand in an inventory, cubes in the same group (below 50% / 50% or more) are matched to the lower one. Full cubes never lose energy. Stacked cubes charge and discharge slower by the number of cubes. Restart the game after changing the stack size.
How many energy cubes fit in one stack. Restart the game (server) after changing it.
When picking up a cube, cubes whose energy differs by at most this many percent are matched to the lower one. 0 = never on pickup (full cubes are never reduced).
minecrafttweak.feature.mod_safety.desc: Checks the mods in your mods folder with Modgrade (modgrade.com) for malware and other problems. It checks on the first start, when mods are added, updated or removed, and after the game crashed. If something is found, the results open on the title screen.
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.line.malware: %s mod(s) with malware found (click for details)
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.line.idle: No changes since last time (click to open)
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.line.idle_scre: Your mods have not changed since the last start, so they were not checked this time. Press "Check again" to check.
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.title: Mod Safety Check (Modgrade)
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.summary: Malware %s, warning %s, passed %s, partly checked %s, not on Modgrade %s
minecrafttweak.mod_safety.notice: "Passed" means no problems were found in the checked files. It does not guarantee a mod is safe.
minecrafttweak.feature.chat_images.desc: Shows images and GIFs in chat. Use the + button on the left of the chat box to attach an image file or an image link. Image links are shown to everyone who has this mod. To send files, the server also needs this mod with this feature turned on.
minecrafttweak.feature.chat_images.max_h: The largest height of an image in chat (GUI pixels). The width is limited to the chat width.
minecrafttweak.feature.chat_images.max_u: The largest image file that can be sent. On a server, the server's own value is also used.
minecrafttweak.feature.chat_images.load_: Loads and shows image links in chat (ending in .png .jpg .jpeg .gif .bmp). Loading a link tells that website your IP address.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.attach.title: Attach an Image
minecrafttweak.chat_images.attach.file_u: This server does not have minEcraft twEEk, so image files cannot be sent. Links still work.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.attach.note: PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP are supported. An attached link is sent through the server like a file.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.error.too_big: The file is too large (up to %s KB).
minecrafttweak.chat_images.error.not_ima: This is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP image.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.error.bad_lin: Enter a link that starts with https:// or http://.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.error.too_lon: This would be longer than the chat limit (256 characters).
minecrafttweak.chat_images.picpop: Click to show it large in the center of the screen (PicPop)
minecrafttweak.chat_images.reason.missin: the server no longer has it
minecrafttweak.chat_images.reason.no_ser: the server does not have this mod
minecrafttweak.chat_images.server_off: Chat Images is turned off on this server.
minecrafttweak.chat_images.server_too_bi: The image is too large (up to %s KB).
minecrafttweak.chat_images.sending_link: Loading and sending the linked image…
minecrafttweak.chat_images.error.link_fa: Could not send the linked image (%s).
minecrafttweak.feature.custom_menu_music: Keeps the music playing everywhere: in worlds, after unpausing and in setting screens (other music does not play while it does).
minecrafttweak.feature.longer_chat.desc: Lets you send chat messages and commands longer than 256 characters. If the server also has this mod with this feature on, long text is sent as is. Otherwise, long chat messages are split into 256-character parts sent once a second (commands cannot be split, so they stay at 256).
minecrafttweak.feature.longer_chat.max_l: The longest text you can type in the chat box (256 to 8000). On a server, the server's own value is also used.
minecrafttweak.longer_chat.command_too_l: This server does not have minEcraft twEEk, so commands are limited to 256 characters (this one has %s).
minecrafttweak.longer_chat.server_off: Longer Chat is turned off on this server.
minecrafttweak.longer_chat.too_long: Too long (up to %s characters on this server).
minecrafttweak.longer_chat.wait: Please wait a moment before sending again.
minecrafttweak.longer_chat.splitting: This server does not have minEcraft twEEk, so the long message is sent in %s parts, one per second.
